purpose: Diagnose whether one approximately constant horizontal georegistration offset in the CD169 EM12 2005 product could explain the cross-year residual mismatch.

reference_support.selection: same geometry-thinned CD169 EM12 2005 support used in support-matched sensitivity

shift_search.apply_shift_to: reported CD169 EM12 support coordinates only
shift_search.2008_depth_estimator: median good-beam depth within 100m of shifted 2005 support coordinate
shift_search.fit: independent best-fit plane per lineage on identical matched support coordinates
shift_search.selection_metric: maximum residual Pearson correlation; ties by higher Spearman then smaller shift magnitude then east/north lexical order

all_required: Pearson gain from zero shift >= 0.15 in both comparisons
best shift vectors for the two independent 2008 lineages differ by <= 100m
